name: shuttle
description: Record your screen and camera, get a link. A small Loom clone on Cloudflare Workers, R2 and D1.
author: Christopher Moravec

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply shuttle --local --env local && wrangler dev --env local
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply shuttle --local --env local
scripts.test: node test/timeline.test.mjs && node test/transcribe.test.mjs && node test/mp4index.test.mjs && node test/redact.test.mjs && node test/api.test.mjs
